paper.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
paper.central_claim: A unified Planner Model–Harness agentic system developed through feedback-driven AI-assisted data production, competence-adaptive reinforcement learning, and deployment/harness revision improves real-world mobile planning, achieving the highest MobilePA-Bench Overall score among evaluated systems at low estimated output cost; multi-round experiments support alternating model training and Harness refinement within evaluated settings.

reason: The project's explicit scope excludes pure API agents. The full report, including executor, tool interface and all appendices, centers on structured tool calls and tool/state-based planning rather than an agent perceiving and acting through GUI surfaces or a separately evaluated GUI mechanism. Mobile deployment, optional visual observations and opaque sub-agent tools do not establish GUI-level evidence. Preserve this exclusion for controller audit; do not count it as a completed scoring review.
rationale: This is an adjacent planner/harness paper, not a low-scoring GUI agent. Its CARE and memory mechanisms may be important to tool-agent research, and the paper explicitly limits co-evolution claims to evaluated development settings. I exclude it under the fixed project scope rather than relabeling its tool-state results as GUI success or assigning zeros. All cached methods, experiments and appendices were read.
